notes:
Two fixes for the TV interface.

THE FEATURED BANNER IS REACHABLE AGAIN ON HOME. Scrolling down through the rows and then walking back up stopped dead at Continue Watching - the banner at the top behaved as though it was not there. It worked on Movies, Series and Anime only because those tabs have a row of genre buttons between the banner and the first row, which the remote could step through on the way up. Home has no genre buttons, so there was nothing to step to. Up now reaches the banner from any row, on every tab.

POSTER HIGHLIGHTS LOOK THE SAME EVERYWHERE. A selected poster in search and in your library was outlined right around the card, title text included, instead of the gold edge around the artwork that the home rows use. Same highlight on every screen now, and the artwork no longer shifts by a hair when you land on it.

Nothing else changed - same streams, same addons, same playback, same profiles.
